title: Starts with
prompt: Show the name of employees whose name starts with A or a. Replace the ___ with a pattern.
hints: % matches any characters after the letter.

cases.name: Different data
cases.setupSql: DELETE FROM employees; DELETE FROM departments; INSERT INTO departments VALUES (5, 'Design'), (6, 'Finance'), (7, 'Ops'); INSERT INTO employees VALUES (11, 'Ivy', 5, NULL, 90000, '2019-02-01', 900, 'ivy@acme.test'), (12, 'Jon', 5, 11, 70000, '2020-06-15', NULL, NULL), (13, 'Kim', 6, 11, 70000, '2023-03-03', 300, 'kim@acme.test'), (14, 'Leo', NULL, 77, 30000, '2024-08-20', NULL, 'leo@acme.test'), (15, 'Mia', 6, 13, 55000, '2022-12-31', 0, 'mia@acme.test'); UPDATE employees SET name = 'Abe' WHERE id = 12;

solutions: SELECT name FROM employees WHERE name LIKE 'A%';

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT name FROM employees WHERE name LIKE '%A';
SELECT name FROM employees WHERE name = 'A%';

title: Ends with
prompt: Show the title of books whose title ends with the letters es.

cases.name: Different data
cases.setupSql: DELETE FROM books; INSERT INTO books VALUES (10, 'Copper Moon', 'Ada Hill', 'Fantasy', 20.0, 100, 2020), (11, 'North Light', 'Raj Dev', 'Travel', 7.5, 180, 2015), (12, 'Sky Atlas', 'Ada Hill', 'Science', 25.0, 300, 2023); UPDATE books SET title = 'Tides' WHERE id = 11; UPDATE books SET title = 'Nestled' WHERE id = 12;

solutions: SELECT title FROM books WHERE title LIKE '%es';

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT title FROM books WHERE title LIKE 'es%';
SELECT title FROM books WHERE title LIKE '%es%';

title: Contains

title: Club emails
prompt: Show the full_name of contacts whose email ends with @club.test.
hints: Match the ending with a leading %.

cases.name: Different data
cases.setupSql: DELETE FROM contacts; INSERT INTO contacts VALUES (11, 'mary jackson', 'mary-j@club.test', '555-0111', 'Hampton', 'SILVER GOLD1'), (12, 'BOB Kahn', 'bob@CLUB.test', '555-0112', NULL, 'gold1'), (13, 'Rosa Park', 'rosa@club-test', NULL, 'Tuskegee', 'NEW'), (14, 'Ken Thompson', 'ken.t@club.test', '5550114', 'Murray', 'GOLD3');

solutions: SELECT full_name FROM contacts WHERE email LIKE '%@club.test';

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT full_name FROM contacts WHERE email LIKE '@club.test%';
SELECT full_name FROM contacts WHERE email LIKE '%@%';

title: A whole code
prompt: A contact's tags are separated by spaces. Show the full_name of contacts with a tag starting GOLD1, either first in the list or after a space. XGOLD1 doesn't count.

cases.name: Different data
cases.setupSql: DELETE FROM contacts; INSERT INTO contacts VALUES (11, 'mary jackson', 'mary-j@club.test', '555-0111', 'Hampton', 'SILVER GOLD1'), (12, 'BOB Kahn', 'bob@CLUB.test', '555-0112', NULL, 'gold1'), (13, 'Rosa Park', 'rosa@club-test', NULL, 'Tuskegee', 'NEW'), (14, 'Ken Thompson', 'ken.t@club.test', '5550114', 'Murray', 'GOLD3');

solutions: SELECT full_name FROM contacts WHERE tags LIKE 'GOLD1%' OR tags LIKE '% GOLD1%';

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT full_name FROM contacts WHERE tags LIKE '%GOLD1%';
SELECT full_name FROM contacts WHERE tags LIKE 'GOLD1%';
wrongSolutions.why: Misses a tag after a space

title: Fix the pattern
prompt: This should show products with the word Note anywhere in their name, but it finds nothing. Fix it.

cases.name: Different data
cases.setupSql: DELETE FROM order_items; DELETE FROM orders; DELETE FROM products; DELETE FROM customers; INSERT INTO customers VALUES (7, 'Ravi', 'Oslo', 'ravi@mail.test', '2024-05-05'), (8, 'Sara', 'Lima', NULL, '2024-06-06'), (9, 'Tom', 'Oslo', NULL, '2024-07-07'); INSERT INTO products VALUES (7, 'Stool', 'Home', 40.0, 25.0), (8, 'Cup', 'Kitchen', 9.0, 2.0), (9, 'Ink', 'Stationery', 12.5, 6.0); INSERT INTO orders VALUES (11, 7, '2024-02-28', 'shipped'), (12, 8, '2024-03-01', 'pending'), (13, 7, '2024-03-31', 'cancelled'); INSERT INTO order_items VALUES (11, 7, 1, 4.0), (11, 8, 3, NULL), (12, 9, 2, NULL), (13, 8, 1, NULL); UPDATE products SET name = 'Sticky Notes' WHERE id = 9;

solutions: SELECT name FROM products WHERE name LIKE '%Note%';

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE name LIKE 'Note';
SELECT name FROM products WHERE name LIKE '%';

title: Outside the club
prompt: Show the full_name of contacts whose email isn't on @club.test, including those with no email.
hints: NOT LIKE skips NULL rows, so add them back.

cases.name: Different data
cases.setupSql: DELETE FROM contacts; INSERT INTO contacts VALUES (11, 'mary jackson', 'mary-j@club.test', '555-0111', 'Hampton', 'SILVER GOLD1'), (12, 'BOB Kahn', 'bob@CLUB.test', '555-0112', NULL, 'gold1'), (13, 'Rosa Park', 'rosa@club-test', NULL, 'Tuskegee', 'NEW'), (14, 'Ken Thompson', 'ken.t@club.test', '5550114', 'Murray', 'GOLD3');

solutions: SELECT full_name FROM contacts WHERE email NOT LIKE '%@club.test' OR email IS NULL;

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT full_name FROM contacts WHERE email NOT LIKE '%@club.test';
SELECT full_name FROM contacts WHERE email IS NULL;
